sentences.en: A vicious dog is attacking people all round the countryside.
sentences.zh: 这头凶猛的狗正在乡下到处攻击人们。

sentences.en: How can we break out of this vicious circle?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么能跳出这个恶性循环？

sentences.en: There seems to be no way out of this vicious circle.
sentences.zh: 似乎没有脱离这个恶性循环的方法。

senses.zh: 凶恶的，恶毒的：desire to inflict；猛烈的：violence or ferocity
